info.title: ebira API
info.description: API for Markdown notes stored as YAML files and searched through a SQLite index.

post.description: Ask a question about the notes. The agent searches and reads the notes, then answers citing the notes it used. Each question is answered on its own, without the earlier ones.

503.description: unavailable: The assistant is not configured, such as when no model API key is set

get.description: Stream note changes as Server-Sent Events. Events missed while disconnected are not replayed; the ready event sent on every (re)connection tells clients to reload the note list.
List notebooks with their note counts: inbox first, then the others by order and name, trash last.

post.description: Create a notebook from its display name. The ID, which is also the directory name, is derived from the name with only the characters an ID allows: an ASCII name is lower-cased with dashes ("My Notes" gives my-notes), and any other name is Punycode-encoded as in internationalized domain names, giving an ID that starts with xn--. A suffix such as -2 is added when the ID is taken.

409.description: already_exists: A notebook with the name exists

put.description: Set the display name, order, kind or note sort of a notebook, creating the notebook if it does not exist. The order of inbox and trash cannot be changed.

400.description: bad_request: The change is not allowed for the notebook, such as an order for inbox or trash

404.description: not_found: The notebook does not exist

delete.description: Move a notebook with its notes and settings into the trash. Inbox and trash cannot be deleted. Fails with already_exists if the trash holds a notebook with the same ID.

400.description: bad_request: The notebook is inbox or trash

404.description: not_found: The notebook does not exist

409.description: already_exists: The trash holds a notebook with the same ID

get.description: List notes in the order of sort, a page at a time: total tells how many there are, and offset reads the next page.

parameters.name: notebook
parameters.description: Only notes in this notebook. Omit for all notebooks except the trash

parameters.name: trashed_notebook
parameters.description: With notebook=trash, list the notes of this notebook in the trash instead of the notes deleted on their own

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the note list: order is the manual order (notes not moved with move come by creation time, newest first), created and updated are newest first, and title is by code point, ignoring case and width. Omit for the sort setting of the notebook (order without a notebook)

400.description: bad_request: trashed_notebook is given without notebook=trash

post.description: Create a note. A random ID is assigned when id is omitted, and the note goes to the inbox when notebook is omitted. A new notebook is created on demand.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the note file. Sent as the ETag header over HTTP

400.description: bad_request: The notebook is the trash or invalid

409.description: already_exists: A note with the ID exists (in any notebook, including the trash)

get.description: Get a note. With q, the result also has the ranges of the title and body matched by the query, as search matches them.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the note file. Sent as the ETag header over HTTP

400.description: bad_request: The ID is used in more than one notebook

404.description: not_found: The note does not exist, or is hidden from the client

delete.description: Move a note to the trash, or delete it permanently if it is already in the trash.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Delete only if the note's current version matches. Omit to delete unconditionally

400.description: bad_request: The note cannot be deleted, such as when its ID is used in more than one notebook

404.description: not_found: The note does not exist

412.description: precondition_failed: If-Match does not match the note's current version

patch.description: Update a note. Omitted attributes are left unchanged. Setting notebook moves the note; use delete to move it to the trash.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Update only if the note's current version matches. Omit to overwrite unconditionally

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the note file. Sent as the ETag header over HTTP

400.description: bad_request: The notebook to move the note to is the trash or invalid

404.description: not_found: The note does not exist

412.description: precondition_failed: If-Match does not match the note's current version

post.description: Put a note right after another note of the same notebook in the manual order (sort order), or first when after is omitted. Only the moved note is written, with its new order; updated_at is kept, as the content does not change.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the note file. Sent as the ETag header over HTTP

400.description: bad_request: The note is in the trash, or after is not another note of its notebook

404.description: not_found: The note does not exist

post.description: Move a note from the trash back to the notebook it was in.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Restore only if the note's current version matches

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the note file. Sent as the ETag header over HTTP

400.description: bad_request: The note is not in the trash, or its notebook exists with another kind

404.description: not_found: The note does not exist

412.description: precondition_failed: If-Match does not match the note's current version

get.description: Search notes. The search mode (like, bigram or ja, Japanese morphological analysis) is set by the server configuration.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms separated by spaces, combined with AND

parameters.name: notebook
parameters.description: Only notes in this notebook. Omit for all notebooks except the trash

post.description: Scan the notes directory and bring the SQLite index in line with the YAML files. Not needed while the server watches files.

get.description: List the notebooks in the trash. List their notes with list, notebook=trash and trashed_notebook.

delete.description: Permanently delete a notebook in the trash with its notes.

400.description: bad_request: The notebook ID is invalid

404.description: not_found: The notebook is not in the trash

post.description: Move a notebook out of the trash with its notes and settings. Fails with already_exists if a notebook with the same ID exists.

400.description: bad_request: The notebook ID is invalid

404.description: not_found: The notebook is not in the trash

409.description: already_exists: A notebook with the same ID exists

id.description: Notebook ID, which is also its directory name

kind.description: Kind of the notebook. AI clients may only read notes in default notebooks, may also create, update and delete notes in collab notebooks, which people share with AI, may only add notes to drop notebooks, whose notes they cannot see, and cannot see private notebooks at all. In the notebook list, AI clients see drop notebooks with a count of 0. A notebook without a kind set is default, except the inbox, which is drop

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the ID (Inbox and Trash for the reserved notebooks)
